description: Returns paginated people matched by name, with optional location narrowing and associated properties. `estimate_cost=true` returns people and associated-property counts without records or credit use. Returned people cost one people credit each; associated properties can consume property credits.

estimate_cost.description: Preview people counts and, when include_properties=true, associated property counts and estimated credits without returning data or consuming credits

fields.description: DealMachine field IDs; people fields return on each person, while property fields return under property and may cost a property credit

include_properties.description: Include associated properties for each person. Costs 1 property data credit per property.

location.description: Optional match location by state, ZIP, county, or numeric city place ID

code.description: State abbreviation, ZIP code, county FIPS, or numeric city place ID

middle_initial.description: Middle initial (single character) to narrow results

name: dealmachine_enrich_name
